s1.desc: a snowy town street with pastel round-roofed igloo buildings

spans.notes: tracking shot: Pax and Polly waddle in place while the street, crossing and a bus scroll past behind them; also only 18 frames

spans.view: with a pale sidewalk and road stripes in front of them and an ice castle in the distance

beats.text: Polly chats happily with her eyes closed, holding a red shell purse, while Pax stands at her side watching her
Pax squeezes his eyes shut and grabs Polly by her purse, yanking her back
Pax and Polly are hidden for a moment as a sled bus speeds past in a blur in front of them
Pax and Polly tumble backward together onto the pavement
Pax and Polly sit side by side on the pavement, staring ahead with wide startled eyes

effects: motion blur on the passing bus
